description_en: Suggests FAQs from the knowledge base based on a user's utterance
description_zh: 根据用户query联想知识库中的FAQ
kebab_example: aliyun chatbot associate --instance-id chatbot-cn-mp90s2lrk00050 --utterance '公积金提取' --perspective FZJBY3raWr --session-id 7c3cec23cc8940bc9db4a318c8f4f0aa --recommend-num 8 --agent-key ac627989eb4f8a98ed05fd098bbae5_p_beebot_public --api-version 2022-04-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Associate

parameters.help_en: The code for a perspective. Use this to retrieve answers from different perspectives that share the same knowledge title. When constructing the request, pass the value in the "Perspective={perspective_code}" format, for example, \&Perspective=["FZJBY3raWr"]. If you use an SDK, pass the parameter as defined by the SDK. You can specify only one perspective in each request
parameters.help_zh: 视角编码，用于调用同一知识标题下不同视角的答案。在拼装请求参数时，需要以Perspective={视角编码}的格式传递参数。如：&Perspective=["FZJBY3raWr"]。使用SDK时以SDK中定义的参数为准。目前仅支持一个视角答案的调用
parameters.name: perspective

parameters.help_en: The session ID that identifies a conversation and maintains context. For the first request from a new user, you can omit this parameter. The service automatically starts a session and returns a session ID in the response. To continue the conversation, you must include the session ID in subsequent requests
parameters.help_zh: 会话ID，用于标识一个访问者的会话和保持上下文信息。对于一个新的访问者，首次调用Chat接口时无需传递此字段，机器人会开启一个会话，并在Chat接口的响应中返回该会话的SessionId。对于该访问者的后续轮次的会话，调用Chat接口时传递当前会话的SessionId，机器人即可基于SessionId继续该轮次会话
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The number of recommended FAQs to return. The value must be an integer from 1 to 10. This parameter takes effect only when recommendations are generated. The number of FAQs returned is less than or equal to the value you specify
parameters.help_zh: 推荐问题数量，1-10，当出推荐的时候才生效，返回小于等于RecommendNum的推荐问题
parameters.name: recommend_num

parameters.help_en: The workspace key. If this parameter is not specified, the service uses the default workspace. You can obtain the key from the workspace management page of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不设置则访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key

items.description_en: The details of a suggested FAQ

Title.description_en: The title of the suggested FAQ
